What this audit is—and is not

A Practical First-Response Review, Not a Full Marketing Audit.

The Lead Leak Audit focuses on the first moments of a new inquiry: public call handling, website contact paths, basic response follow-up, and visible Google Business Profile basics. It does not replace a full website, SEO, advertising, technical-security, legal, or compliance audit.
